note: `json_unpack_call.call_buffer_is_c_string` is a semantic view over the vulnerable harness call `libgps_json_unpack((char *)Data, &gpsdata, NULL)`: the emitted 0/1 value records whether the actual first argument supplied at that call site is already a NUL-terminated C string. The authoritative fixed image computes the same semantic view on its repaired `DataFx` buffer, but bindings remain anchored to the vulnerable original expression. The literal operand `json_unpack_call.true_literal` is intentionally omitted because the validator treats `*.true_literal` as a compile-time literal rather than a vulnerable-source expression.
